title: Topography of Model Supply and Customer Traction Profiles
creator: Diego Marquez
description: Create a compact, evidence-driven map of model supply (regional availability, quantization/variant coverage, latency tiers) overlaid with observed customer traction signals (active deployments, latency sensitivity, vertical adoption) to inform procurement triggers, fallback policies, and Dedicated capacity bundling. This ticket scopes the research plan, scoring rubric, probe design, and an output artifact (topography map + dataset + recommendation memo).
acceptance_criteria: 1) A topography visual (SVG + CSV) covering NA/EU/APAC with model-variant rows and supply attributes (availability, quantized variants, estimated tail latency, infra affinity). 2) A customer-traction matrix (CSV) that links observed signals to model families and vertical cohorts. 3) Scoring rubric and README describing scoring heuristics, data sources, and limitations. 4) Recommendation memo with 3 tactical product responses and ops triggers. 5) Hand-off folder (Confluence + Drive links) with reproducible queries and dashboards.
proposed_research_plan: Phase A (2 days): assemble telemetry and procurement feeds (usage telemetry, SRE incidence logs, field rep notes). Phase B (4 days): automated probes — run synthetic workloads (short/long contexts) across candidate model variants in target regions to collect latency & error signatures. Phase C (3 days): qualitative syncs with Sales & Solutions (5 customers) to capture traction/contextual constraints. Phase D (2 days): scoring, map generation, and write recommendations. Total ~11 work-days (spread across two sprints).
deliverables: - topography-map-2026Q1.svg, - model-supply-matrix-2026Q1.csv, - traction-matrix-2026Q1.csv, - scoring-rubric.md, - recommendations-memo.md, - confluence-page-link
stakeholders: PM: Nora Li; Research lead: Priya Anand; Infra/Eng reviewer: Kenji Sato; Solutions: Maya Patel; Sales lead (field): Carlos Alvarez; SRE contact: Elena Morozova
timeline: Kickoff 2026-03-11; Data collection 2026-03-12 to 2026-03-18; Synthesis 2026-03-19 to 2026-03-24; Draft memo 2026-03-25; Review 2026-03-26 to 2026-03-30; Final deliverables 2026-04-01.
risks_and_tradeoffs: - Telemetry bias: hosted customers dominate usage telemetry; will weight field interviews and partner snapshots to reduce bias. - Probe cost: synthetic probing may incur GPU spend; restrict sample to representative model families and short/long context extremes. - Freshness: model availability can change quickly; the artifact will include version timestamps and recommended refresh cadence (biweekly for high-risk regions).
next_steps: 1) Nora to confirm stakeholder list and customer interview candidates (due 2026-03-12). 2) Infra to approve synthetic probe plan and quota (Kenji). 3) Create shared Drive folder and Confluence page templates. 4) Assign data queries to Research intern (Priya).
